title: Profilin-regulated actin polymerization dynamics at high monomer concentrations
task: Characterize profilin-regulated actin polymerization kinetics and precision at high monomer concentrations
key_results: Identified profilin-dependent Michaelis constant for growth speed saturation; actin growth precision dramatically improves via profilin regulation, approaching thermodynamic uncertainty relation bounds
comments: The four-reaction kinetic model provides mechanistic insight, but experimental validation of predicted stall force and precise measurement of all rate constants remain outstanding.

model_io.model: Four-reaction kinetic model of profilin-actin polymerization

hypotheses.hypothesis: Profilin binding controls maximal F-actin polymerization speed via Michaelis-Menten-like saturation at cellular concentrations
hypotheses.result: Kinetic model successfully predicts saturation behavior and reveals profilin-dependent Michaelis constant

hypotheses.hypothesis: Profilin regulation increases actin polymerization precision toward thermodynamic bounds
hypotheses.result: Length diffusivity calculations show dramatic precision improvement; unique stall force indicates energetically balanced profilin-driven polymerization

title: Biomass-derived bamboo photonic crystals for narrowband lasing
task: Develop biocompatible narrowband multicolor lasing using bamboo photonic crystals
key_results: Achieved narrowband multicolor lasing by coupling quantum dot emission to bamboo-derived photonic crystals; simplified preparation via natural hierarchical microstructure while maintaining biocompatibility and biodegradability
comments: While innovative in material selection, the paper lacks quantitative metrics on lasing efficiency, linewidth, or wavelength tunability range compared to conventional synthetic substrates.

model_io.model: Bamboo photonic crystal coupled to quantum dots

hypotheses.hypothesis: Bamboo's cellulose-lignin-hemicellulose composition with large refractive index differences and lignin photoluminescence resistance enables PC functionality
hypotheses.result: Successfully demonstrated narrowband multicolor lasing with biocompatibility and biodegradability retained

title: Targeting mutant p53 aggregates in pancreatic cancer using an autophagy-targeting chimera
task: Target mutant p53 aggregates via autophagy using AUTOTAC platform in pancreatic cancer
key_results: ATC-37 suppressed mutant p53 GOF signaling and inhibited tumor growth in PANC-1 xenografts; reduced amyloid-like aggregates; enhanced radiation response; dual mechanism: low-dose autophagic degradation, high-dose proteotoxic sequestration
comments: The concentration-dependent dual mechanism is elegant but dosing strategy for in vivo efficacy and tolerability requires careful optimization.

model_io.model: PANC-1 pancreatic cancer cells and xenografts

hypotheses.hypothesis: AUTOTAC targeting of p53 aggregates promotes autophagic degradation
hypotheses.result: Confirmed at low concentrations; suppressed GOF signaling

hypotheses.hypothesis: ATC-37 enhances radiation response in mutant p53 cancers
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; improved response in combination

title: A novel HIF1α stabilizer prevents apoptosis and promotes a senescence-like phenotype in photoreceptor cells

key_results: Stabilizer 1a reduced cleaved caspase-3 and annexin V labeling under hypoxic stress; preserved ATP levels and reduced ROS; induced reversible senescence-like phenotype with increased p16/p21

model_io.model: 661W cone photoreceptor-like cells
Murine retinal detachment model in vivo

hypotheses.hypothesis: HIF1α stabilization protects PRs from hypoxia-induced cell death
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; reduced apoptosis markers and preserved cellular function

title: WASH orchestrates phagosomal maturation and bacterial killing in neutrophils through syntaxin 19-mediated lysosomal fusion

key_results: WASH deficiency impaired lysosome-phagosome fusion and bacterial killing; WASH recruits STX19 to phagosomes; STX19 overexpression enhanced phagosomal maturation

model_io.model: WASH-deficient and wild-type neutrophils

hypotheses.hypothesis: WASH regulates phagosomal maturation through STX19-mediated membrane fusion
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; STX19 interference impaired maturation, overexpression enhanced it

hypotheses.hypothesis: Rac1 activation rescues lysosomal trafficking
hypotheses.result: Partially confirmed; rescued trafficking but not phagosomal maturation

title: Antagonistic second-messenger signalling coordinates Pseudomonas aeruginosa surface colonization and virulence

key_results: cAMP and c-di-GMP establish mutually exclusive signaling states; surface contact triggers c-di-GMP increase activating FimW; cAMP inactivates FimW and induces motility and virulence; both adhesion and motility required for tissue invasion
comments: The elegant mechanistic model of binary signaling states explains phenotypic heterogeneity but temporal dynamics of the transition in vivo need further characterization.

model_io.model: P. aeruginosa planktonic and surface-attached populations
Human airway tissue model

hypotheses.hypothesis: cAMP and c-di-GMP establish mutually exclusive signaling states at single-cell level

key_results: Placebo showed 9.3-fold increased active caspase-3, 2.8-fold increased Bax, 3.2-fold reduced Bcl-xL; all therapies reduced caspase-3+ cells; methylprednisolone and camostat reduced histological injury; methylprednisolone reduced Bax dimer, camostat increased Bcl-xL most

hypotheses.hypothesis: Delayed inhaled therapy modulates apoptosis-related proteins and reduces late remodeling

title: Evaluating weakly supervised deep segmentation trained on radiometric pseudo labels for thermal fault screening in electrical substations
